title: Sparkplug Cloud
description: The Sparkplug alarms demo's HUB half of the notification question: one alarm pipeline, CloudNotify, whose Script block calls sp_cloud.notify and answers the edge through an Engine tag (DCMD). Deployed to the hub BY NAME by scripts/sparkplug-setup.sh -- it sits beside SparkplugEdge so that ign-deploy.sh --all never sweeps it onto another gateway.
